skill.name: tiktok获取作品评论

vid.title: Video ID or URL
vid.description: Required target. Use the full video URL to avoid ambiguity when entering a numeric ID.

count.title: Maximum comments to return
count.description: Maximum number of comments. The actual count depends on login state, comment availability, and page access.

maxScrollTimes.title: Maximum scrolls
maxScrollTimes.description: Upper limit for loading more comments. Stops early when the target count is reached.

sortBy.title: Comment sort order
sortBy.description: platform keeps TikTok’s returned order; other options sort by fields available on the page.

pageLoadWaitSeconds.title: Video page wait (seconds)
pageLoadWaitSeconds.description: Wait for video details and the comments entry point to load.

tabWaitSeconds.title: Additional comments wait (seconds)
tabWaitSeconds.description: Wait for comment data after the comments entry appears or a tab switch is attempted.

scrollWaitSeconds.title: Wait after each scroll (seconds)
scrollWaitSeconds.description: Increase this on slower pages. A short wait may miss newly loaded comments.

saveResults.title: Save comments and video to Tobub
saveResults.description: When enabled, save results and link them to the video. When disabled, return results only.

fields.label: Video ID or URL
fields.description: Enter a TikTok video ID or full video URL.

fields.label: Maximum comments to return
fields.description: Maximum comments to return; fewer may be available.

fields.label: Comment sort order
fields.description: Choose platform order, newest, or most liked.

fields.label: Maximum scrolls
fields.description: Loading limit; stops early when the target count is reached.

fields.label: Video page wait (seconds)
fields.description: Wait for video details and the comments entry point.

fields.label: Additional comments wait (seconds)
fields.description: Additional wait after opening the comments panel.

fields.label: Wait after each scroll (seconds)
fields.description: Increase this on slower pages; a short wait may miss comments.

fields.label: Save comments and video to Tobub
fields.description: When enabled, save and link results; otherwise return results only.

metadata.description: 读取指定 TikTok 作品的评论，可控制数量、排序和加载等待；支持预览或保存，并自动去重、关联作品。
